title: Staring app citizen-science project
summary: Rupert Sheldrake tells of Staring app citizen-science project, about 2024 at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm just releasing an app at the moment which works on cell phones uh where you can train yourself to get better at it

plain: Rupert Sheldrake, a British biologist known for unusual ideas about the mind, tells a podcast host in 2024 that he is releasing a phone app about the feeling of being stared at. According to Sheldrake, people can use the app to train themselves to get better at sensing a stare, which, if it works, would suggest the mind reaches beyond the body.
